Pharmacist Job at LifeBank




        
    

        
        LifeBank is a technology company that powers hospitals and care centers to deliver quality healthcare to patients in emerging markets. The company’s technology, infrastructure, agile production, and distribution networks enable hospitals in emerging markets to catch up with their global peers. The company has distributed 45,000+ medical products to 1000+ healthcare facilities, saving 18,000+ lives across Nigeria, Ethiopia and Kenya. At LifeBank, we are the technology-led healthcare system for the future.

We are recruiting to fill the position below: 

 Job Position: Pharmacist

Job Location: Onipanu, Lagos
Employment Type: Contract

Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Lead PCN licensing and registration activities.
	Serve as Superintendent Pharmacist for the wholesale facility.
	Provide licence coverage for the registered premises.
	Ensure compliance with PCN regulations and Good Distribution Practice (GDP).
	Prepare for and coordinate regulatory inspections.
	Develop pharmaceutical quality management systems.
	Develop SOPs and regulatory documentation.
	Oversee pharmaceutical inventory governance.
	Maintain statutory records and licence renewals.
	Train warehouse personnel on pharmaceutical handling standards.
	Liaise with regulatory agencies including PCN, NAFDAC and relevant government authorities.
	Provide regulatory guidance for new pharmaceutical partnerships.
	Ensure continuous compliance with all applicable legislation.


Qualifications


	Interested candidates should possess a B.Sc Degree with 3 - 5 years of experience. 


Salary
N200,000 - N250,000 monthly.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their applications and CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Finance Lead&nbsp;

Job Location: Onipan, Lagos

Employment Type: Full-time
Department: Finance
Reports to: Chief Executive Officer (CEO)

Job Summary


	The Finance Lead is the highest-ranking finance professional in the Company and is responsible for overseeing and controlling all financial functions of the business.
	The role provides financial leadership to the Company and ensures strong financial management, accurate reporting, effective cash flow management, financial controls, compliance, and informed decision-making.
	A key focus of the role is management accounting &mdash; providing Management and the CEO with timely, accurate, and actionable financial information to understand the Company&#39;s performance, manage costs, improve profitability, and make sound business decisions.


Key Responsibilities


	Lead and oversee all finance and accounting functions of the Company, including management accounting, financial reporting, treasury, payables, receivables, collections, budgeting, and financial controls.
	Prepare and present accurate and timely monthly management accounts, financial reports, and business performance analysis to the CEO and Management.
	Provide clear analysis of revenue, costs, margins, cash flow, profitability, variances, and overall financial performance.
	Develop and manage the Company&#39;s annual budget, forecasts, financial plans, and regular reforecasts.
	Monitor cash flow and working capital, ensuring the Company has adequate visibility of its financial position and upcoming obligations.
	Oversee accounts receivable, collections, payables, and supplier obligations to ensure effective working capital management.
	Establish and maintain strong financial controls, processes, approval systems, and financial policies across the business.
	Ensure accurate and timely bank, customer, vendor, payroll, and other financial reconciliations.
	Monitor financial performance across business units and identify areas of financial risk, inefficiency, overspending, or opportunity.
	Ensure compliance with applicable tax, statutory, regulatory, accounting, and reporting requirements.
	Lead the preparation and coordination of internal and external audits.
	Provide financial guidance and analysis for business decisions, investments, pricing, expansion, cost management, and other strategic initiatives.
	Ensure the integrity, completeness, and accuracy of the Company&#39;s financial records and systems.
	Develop financial dashboards and reports that give Management clear visibility into the Company&#39;s financial position and performance.
	Lead, manage, and develop the Finance team, ensuring clear accountability and effective execution across all finance functions.
	Work closely with the CEO and other business leaders to align financial management with the Company&#39;s operational and strategic objectives.
	Identify opportunities to improve financial efficiency, reduce costs, strengthen controls, and improve profitability.
	Perform any other reasonable duties required by the CEO.


Management Accounting Focus:


	The Finance Lead is expected to go beyond recording financial transactions and provide Management with a clear understanding of what the numbers mean for the business.


This includes:


	Monthly management accounts and financial performance reviews.
	Budget vs. actual analysis and variance reporting.
	Revenue, gross margin, and profitability analysis.
	Business unit and product-level financial analysis.
	Cash flow forecasting and working capital analysis.
	Cost analysis and cost-control recommendations.
	Financial modelling and scenario planning.
	Identification of financial risks and opportunities.
	Providing actionable recommendations to the CEO and Management.


Key Performance Indicators


	Accuracy and timeliness of monthly management accounts.
	Quality and usefulness of financial analysis provided to Management.
	Accuracy of budgets, forecasts, and cash flow projections.
	Cash flow and working capital management.
	Revenue, cost, margin, and profitability visibility.
	Effective management of receivables and payables.
	Timely completion of reconciliations and financial reporting.
	Compliance with statutory and regulatory obligations.
	Strength and effectiveness of financial controls.
	Audit readiness and timely resolution of audit findings.
	Overall effectiveness and performance of the Finance function.


Requirements


	Bachelor&#39;s Degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or a related field.
	5+ years of relevant finance and accounting experience, with significant experience leading a finance function.
	Professional qualification such as ICAN, ACCA, or equivalent is strongly preferred.
	Strong experience in management accounting, financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, and financial analysis.
	Strong understanding of treasury, accounts payable, accounts receivable, collections, payroll, taxation, and financial controls.
	Experience managing and developing a finance team.
	Strong proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and accounting or ERP systems.
	Strong commercial and business understanding, with the ability to translate financial information into actionable business decisions.
	Excellent analytical, communication, and leadership skills.
	High level of integrity, attention to detail, and accountability.
	Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced and evolving business environment.


Key Competencies:


	Management Accounting
	Financial Planning &amp; Analysis
	Financial Reporting
	Cash Flow &amp; Treasury Management
	Budgeting &amp; Forecasting
	Financial Controls &amp; Risk Management
	Commercial Acumen
	Strategic Thinking
	Leadership &amp; Team Management
	Data Analysis &amp; Decision-Making
	Integrity and Accountability.


Salary
N450,000 - N600,000 monthly.

Method of Application&nbsp;
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CVs / Resume to: team@lifebank.ng using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

  "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "Business Development Manager / Commercial Manager",
  "description": "Vantegral Consulting is well-positioned to provide innovative and consultative solutions for human, entrepreneurial, and technological advancement and development. Our Human Capacity Development solutions include&nbsp;Recruitment and Talent Acquisition Services, Training and Development Programs, Outsourcing and Support, and Executive Search.&nbsp;

We take a human-centered and evidence-driven approach to understand the challenges and opportunities in our sectors, and we proffer bespoke solutions carefully designed to meet the ever-evolving needs of already established businesses and teething start-ups. This enables us to support our clients to achieve their aims for transformation, culture change and Human Capacity Development within organisations and communities.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Business Development Manager / Commercial Manager

Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

About the Role


	We are seeking a highly driven and commercially astute Business Development Manager / Commercial Manager to lead business growth, client acquisition and commercial development across its marine, offshore, oil &amp; gas, logistics, transportation, energy and supply-chain operations.
	The successful candidate will be responsible for identifying high-value business opportunities, developing strategic client relationships, driving the company&#39;s commercial pipeline, leading bids and proposals, negotiating contracts and converting opportunities into profitable business.
	The ideal candidate should bring strong industry knowledge, an established network of relevant decision-makers and a proven track record of generating revenue and winning contracts within the Nigerian Oil &amp; Gas, Marine, Offshore, Logistics or Energy sectors.


Responsibilities
Business Development &amp; Market Expansion:


	Develop and implement business development strategies to achieve the company&#39;s revenue and growth objectives.
	Identify and pursue new business opportunities across the Oil &amp; Gas, Marine, Offshore, Energy, Logistics and Supply Chain sectors.
	Conduct market research to identify emerging opportunities, new projects, industry trends and potential clients.
	Develop and maintain a robust pipeline of qualified prospects and commercial opportunities.
	Identify new markets, service opportunities and potential revenue streams for Langley Express.
	Convert identified opportunities into client meetings, proposals, negotiations and awarded contracts.
	Develop strategies to increase Langley&#39;s market share within its target sectors.


Strategic Client Acquisition &amp; Relationship Management:


	Build and maintain relationships with senior decision-makers across target organizations.
	Develop strong connections with Procurement, Commercial, Supply Chain, Operations, Marine, Projects and Contract Management teams.
	Identify and map key stakeholders within prospective client organizations.
	Develop and manage strategic accounts to maximize business opportunities and long-term revenue.
	Represent Langley Express at client meetings, industry events, conferences, exhibitions and business networking platforms.
	Maintain regular engagement with existing and prospective clients to identify new opportunities.
	Develop relationships that position Langley as a preferred service provider.


Oil &amp; Gas, Marine &amp; Offshore Business Development:


	Develop a strong understanding of the Nigerian Oil &amp; Gas, Marine and Offshore business environment.
	Identify organizations requiring marine logistics, offshore support, transportation, haulage, terminal operations, supply-chain and related services.
	Monitor upcoming projects, developments, procurement activities and potential contract opportunities.
	Develop and maintain a target-client database covering:
	
		International Oil Companies (IOCs)
		Indigenous Oil &amp; Gas companies
		EPC/EPCI contractors
		Oilfield service companies
		Marine and offshore operators
		Terminal operators
		Energy companies
		Logistics and supply-chain organizations
	
	
	
	Identify opportunities across Lagos and other strategic Oil &amp; Gas locations within Nigeria.&nbsp;

	Nigeriajob market report
	


Tender, Proposal &amp; Contract Development:


	Identify and monitor relevant tenders, RFQs, RFPs and procurement opportunities.
	Lead the business development component of tender and proposal processes.
	Coordinate with technical, operations, finance and management teams to develop competitive proposals.
	Review client requirements, scopes of work and commercial terms.
	Develop and present compelling commercial proposals aligned with client requirements.
	Lead or support contract negotiations with prospective clients.
	Ensure proposals and commercial submissions meet client requirements and internal profitability expectations.
	Maintain an organized database of active, upcoming and completed bids.


Commercial Strategy &amp; Revenue Management:


	Develop commercial strategies that support sustainable revenue and profitability.
	Conduct competitor and market analysis to support pricing and business decisions.
	Evaluate the commercial viability, risks and potential returns of prospective contracts.
	Support the development of pricing structures in collaboration with management and relevant departments.
	Negotiate pricing, payment terms, contract conditions and other commercial considerations.
	Protect company margins while remaining competitive in the market.
	Provide management with accurate revenue forecasts and pipeline projections.


Strategic Partnerships &amp; Business Alliances:


	Identify potential strategic partners that can expand Langley&#39;s service capabilities and market reach.
	Develop relationships with vessel operators, contractors, logistics providers, service companies and other complementary businesses.
	Explore opportunities for joint ventures, subcontracting arrangements and strategic partnerships.
	Identify opportunities for Langley to participate as a prime contractor, subcontractor or strategic service partner.
	Develop partnerships that create sustainable commercial opportunities for the company.


Pipeline &amp; Performance Management:


	Maintain an accurate and continuously updated business development pipeline.
	Track opportunities from initial identification through to contract award and implementation.
	Establish priorities across prospects based on commercial value, probability of conversion and strategic importance.
	Prepare regular business development and commercial reports for management.
	Monitor performance against agreed revenue and business development targets.
	Provide insights and recommendations based on market activity, client feedback and competitor movements.


Requirements


	Bachelor&#39;s Degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Economics, Engineering, Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Maritime Studies or a related discipline.
	Relevant professional qualifications in Business Development, Sales, Supply Chain, Procurement, Maritime, Oil &amp; Gas or Project Management will be an advantage.
	An MBA or relevant postgraduate qualification is an added advantage.


Experiences:


	5&ndash;8+ years of relevant professional experience in Business Development, Commercial Management, Sales, Strategic Accounts or a related commercial function.
	Proven experience generating new business and securing commercial contracts.
	Demonstrable experience selling B2B services to corporate clients.
	Experience managing complex sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders.
	Proven experience with tenders, RFQs, RFPs and commercial proposals.
	Experience engaging senior procurement, commercial, supply-chain and operational decision-makers.
	Strong understanding of the Nigerian commercial and procurement environment.


Competencies:
The successful candidate should demonstrate:


	Business Development &amp; Sales
	Commercial Strategy
	Contract Negotiation
	Tender &amp; Proposal Management
	Strategic Account Management
	Market Development
	Client Relationship Management
	Industry Networking
	Revenue Generation
	Commercial &amp; Financial Acumen
	Market Intelligence
	Stakeholder Management
	Strategic Thinking
	Communication &amp; Presentation
	Negotiation &amp; Influencing
	Results Orientation.

This enables us to support our clients to achieve their aims for transformation, culture change and Human Capacity Development within organisations and communities.
     

            
    



We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Business Development Manager / Commercial Manager

Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

About the Role


	We are seeking a highly driven and commercially astute Business Development Manager / Commercial Manager to lead business growth, client acquisition and commercial development across its marine, offshore, oil & gas, logistics, transportation, energy and supply-chain operations.
	The successful candidate will be responsible for identifying high-value business opportunities, developing strategic client relationships, driving the company's commercial pipeline, leading bids and proposals, negotiating contracts and converting opportunities into profitable business.
	The ideal candidate should bring strong industry knowledge, an established network of relevant decision-makers and a proven track record of generating revenue and winning contracts within the Nigerian Oil & Gas, Marine, Offshore, Logistics or Energy sectors.


Responsibilities
Business Development & Market Expansion:


	Develop and implement business development strategies to achieve the company's revenue and growth objectives.
	Identify and pursue new business opportunities across the Oil & Gas, Marine, Offshore, Energy, Logistics and Supply Chain sectors.
	Conduct market research to identify emerging opportunities, new projects, industry trends and potential clients.
	Develop and maintain a robust pipeline of qualified prospects and commercial opportunities.
	Identify new markets, service opportunities and potential revenue streams for Langley Express.
	Convert identified opportunities into client meetings, proposals, negotiations and awarded contracts.
	Develop strategies to increase Langley's market share within its target sectors.


Strategic Client Acquisition & Relationship Management:


	Build and maintain relationships with senior decision-makers across target organizations.
	Develop strong connections with Procurement, Commercial, Supply Chain, Operations, Marine, Projects and Contract Management teams.
	Identify and map key stakeholders within prospective client organizations.
	Develop and manage strategic accounts to maximize business opportunities and long-term revenue.
	Represent Langley Express at client meetings, industry events, conferences, exhibitions and business networking platforms.
	Maintain regular engagement with existing and prospective clients to identify new opportunities.
	Develop relationships that position Langley as a preferred service provider.


Oil & Gas, Marine & Offshore Business Development:


	Develop a strong understanding of the Nigerian Oil & Gas, Marine and Offshore business environment.
	Identify organizations requiring marine logistics, offshore support, transportation, haulage, terminal operations, supply-chain and related services.
	Monitor upcoming projects, developments, procurement activities and potential contract opportunities.
	Develop and maintain a target-client database covering:
	
		International Oil Companies (IOCs)
		Indigenous Oil & Gas companies
		EPC/EPCI contractors
		Oilfield service companies
		Marine and offshore operators
		Terminal operators
		Energy companies
		Logistics and supply-chain organizations
	
	
	
	Identify opportunities across Lagos and other strategic Oil & Gas locations within Nigeria. 

	Nigeriajob market report
	


Tender, Proposal & Contract Development:


	Identify and monitor relevant tenders, RFQs, RFPs and procurement opportunities.
	Lead the business development component of tender and proposal processes.
	Coordinate with technical, operations, finance and management teams to develop competitive proposals.
	Review client requirements, scopes of work and commercial terms.
	Develop and present compelling commercial proposals aligned with client requirements.
	Lead or support contract negotiations with prospective clients.
	Ensure proposals and commercial submissions meet client requirements and internal profitability expectations.
	Maintain an organized database of active, upcoming and completed bids.


Commercial Strategy & Revenue Management:


	Develop commercial strategies that support sustainable revenue and profitability.
	Conduct competitor and market analysis to support pricing and business decisions.
	Evaluate the commercial viability, risks and potential returns of prospective contracts.
	Support the development of pricing structures in collaboration with management and relevant departments.
	Negotiate pricing, payment terms, contract conditions and other commercial considerations.
	Protect company margins while remaining competitive in the market.
	Provide management with accurate revenue forecasts and pipeline projections.


Strategic Partnerships & Business Alliances:


	Identify potential strategic partners that can expand Langley's service capabilities and market reach.
	Develop relationships with vessel operators, contractors, logistics providers, service companies and other complementary businesses.
	Explore opportunities for joint ventures, subcontracting arrangements and strategic partnerships.
	Identify opportunities for Langley to participate as a prime contractor, subcontractor or strategic service partner.
	Develop partnerships that create sustainable commercial opportunities for the company.


Pipeline & Performance Management:


	Maintain an accurate and continuously updated business development pipeline.
	Track opportunities from initial identification through to contract award and implementation.
	Establish priorities across prospects based on commercial value, probability of conversion and strategic importance.
	Prepare regular business development and commercial reports for management.
	Monitor performance against agreed revenue and business development targets.
	Provide insights and recommendations based on market activity, client feedback and competitor movements.


Requirements


	Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Economics, Engineering, Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Maritime Studies or a related discipline.
	Relevant professional qualifications in Business Development, Sales, Supply Chain, Procurement, Maritime, Oil & Gas or Project Management will be an advantage.
	An MBA or relevant postgraduate qualification is an added advantage.


Experiences:


	5–8+ years of relevant professional experience in Business Development, Commercial Management, Sales, Strategic Accounts or a related commercial function.
	Proven experience generating new business and securing commercial contracts.
	Demonstrable experience selling B2B services to corporate clients.
	Experience managing complex sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders.
	Proven experience with tenders, RFQs, RFPs and commercial proposals.
	Experience engaging senior procurement, commercial, supply-chain and operational decision-makers.
	Strong understanding of the Nigerian commercial and procurement environment.


Competencies:
The successful candidate should demonstrate:


	Business Development & Sales
	Commercial Strategy
	Contract Negotiation
	Tender & Proposal Management
	Strategic Account Management
	Market Development
	Client Relationship Management
	Industry Networking
	Revenue Generation
	Commercial & Financial Acumen
	Market Intelligence
	Stakeholder Management
	Strategic Thinking
	Communication & Presentation
	Negotiation & Influencing
	Results Orientation.
